method: In-app sidebar Inbox entry read directly from each app's own DOM, no writes needed.

meologue.sidebarWordingObserved: Also seen live in this session's sidebar snapshot: 'Reporting' (not 'Activity') and 'My Projects' as a real anchor to /todo/projects (not a plain heading) -- both were NAV-01/NAV-11 defects in the original audit and now read the same as Todoist's wording. Not re-measured node-for-node against Todoist's Reporting/My Projects DOM in this round since the row asked for is specifically the count-placement fix; recorded here as an observation, not claimed as a separately-verified match.

verdict.note: The specific ask for this row -- the visible count is now a SIBLING of the <a> (a separate <span>'9'/'15'), the <a>'s own textContent is only 'Inbox', and the aria-label carries the count ('Inbox, N tasks') -- is satisfied identically in both apps. meologue's <nav> still carries aria-label="Todo" where Todoist's <nav> has none; that is the separate NAV-04 divergence (meologue deliberately more accessible), already recorded as a decision, not counted against this row.
